title: Normalize asterisk request targets in request URL properties
answers: How should an asterisk request target appear in the request URL?
Why does a request URL have a trailing star?
Where should '*' be handled for pretty URLs?
body:
Invariant: Request URL properties must render the '*' request target as an empty URL path while preserving the stored request path.
Enforcement: mitmproxy/http.py:Request.url and mitmproxy/http.py:Request.pretty_url each normalize the path before calling url.unparse.
Layering: mitmproxy/net/http/url.py:unparse appends the supplied path without interpreting '*'; request-target semantics belong in the request properties.
Constraints: Keep both properties aligned when composing full URLs; Request.url retains its separate authority-format branch. Skipping normalization appends '*' to the rendered URL.
applies: Changes to request URL rendering or asterisk-target handling.
